To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cell hybrid between human neuroblastom cells and thymine auxotrophs from rat nerve‐like cell produced a stable cell line that undergoes spontaneous and cAMP‐induced neuronal differentiation.
the cell hybrids between human and rat cells showed partial reverse‐transfornation and that the cAMP‐dependent pathway is involved in the induction of the nerve‐like phenotype of the cell hybrids.
the cell hybrids between human IMR‐32 cells and thymine‐auxotrophs of the rat B103 cells exhibited the properties of partial transformation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the production of a cell line that undergoes stable neuronal differentiation and the establishment of a new system for studying mechanisms of neuronal differentiation.
the development of a cell line that can be used as a model for the analysis of neuronal differentiation and cell transformation.
the production of stable nerve‐like cells by hybridization between human neuroblastomas and rat thymidine auxotropic nerve‐like cells and the induction of a differentiated phenotype by various drugs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
cell hybridization of transformed cells and non‐transformed cells can produce a partial normalization in the transformed cells.
BIM cells represent an example of a hybrid cell line that has the properties of a partial transformation and that is able to be induced to differentiate by various drugs, including db‐cAMP.
BIM cells are a model system for studying the mechanism of neuronal differentiation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the cell hybrids obtained between human neuroblastomas and rat nerve‐like thymidine auxo‐trophs can be used as a model for the study of mechanisms involved in differentiation and transformation of neuronal cells.
the cell hybridization technique is useful for studying the molecular mechanism of the regulation of the cell cycle and differentiation.
BIM cells are useful for studying the mechanism of the regulation of cell growth and the induction of differentiation in nerve cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cell hybridization can be used as a tool to study molecular mechanisms of the regulation of neuronal differentiation.
cell hybridization is a powerful tool for the study of cell differentiation.
cell hybridization is an efficient method for producing cell lines with a nerve‐like differentiated phenotype.
